title: The stand-up is at 12:00, not 13:00: the deck and your briefing are ready; two votes in
headline: Angelo moved today's stand-up to 12:00 (relayed by Vicky's logistics agent); the schedule said 13:00, so the site, the agenda and the briefings now say 12:00, keeping the meeting's id so no item moved.
